name: create_niagara_system
purpose: Create a new, immediately-usable NiagaraSystem asset, optionally seeded from an emitter asset, without the template-picker UI.
cooked: degraded — new systems work; seeding from cooked emitter must be refused (crash)
hazards: AddEmitterToSystem crashes on cooked emitter/system (null-deref :2130, CastChecked :2109) — pre-check GetEditorData()
UNiagaraSystem::PreSave blocks via WaitForCompilationComplete — gate save_package on outstanding=0

name: spawn_niagara_component
purpose: Spawn a one-shot/pooled Niagara FX component at a location in the editor or PIE world — runtime spawn path spawn_actor_in_level lacks.
cooked: works — runtime data is what ships; exercises the game's 38 cooked systems
hazards: FNiagaraWorldManager::Get deref'd without null check on pre-cull path — do not pass exotic preview worlds

name: set_niagara_user_parameter
purpose: Set a User.* parameter on any UNiagaraComponent — user params live in a serialized parameter store, unreachable by set_property.
cooked: works — user parameter store is runtime data
hazards: Setters silently create/ignore unknown params — endpoint must pre-check ReadParameterVariables and error

name: get_niagara_user_parameters
purpose: Enumerate a component's or system's user parameters with types and current values — the read/verification pair of the setter.

name: set_niagara_component_active
purpose: Activate / deactivate / reset a Niagara component so an agent can drive FX state during PIE verification without console hacks.
hazards: Pooled components must never enter the undo stack — no transaction on transient activation state

name: get_niagara_particle_counts
purpose: Per-emitter live particle counts plus execution state for any active Niagara component — the axis's numeric verification primitive.
hazards: GetNumParticlesGPUInternal is private — only reachable via public FORCEINLINE GetNumParticles
GPU emitters report latent counts — return a gpuLatent flag per GPU emitter

name: niagara_compile_request
purpose: Request (re)compilation of a NiagaraSystem's scripts after authoring mutations and poll completion — compilation is multi-frame.
cooked: refuses — cannot recompile cooked Niagara systems (engine also self-refuses)
hazards: Never call WaitForCompilationComplete (NiagaraSystem.h:409) — blocks game thread in FScopedSlowTask
PreSave blocks while compile outstanding — never save_package until poll shows outstanding=0

name: add_niagara_emitter
purpose: Add an emitter (copied from an emitter asset) to an existing loose NiagaraSystem — the one structural authoring op with a clean export.
cooked: refuses — endpoint-enforced pre-check; the engine path crashes on cooked input
hazards: AddEmitterToSystem CastChecked asserts (:2109) / null-derefs (:2130) on missing editor data — pre-check both
AddEmitterToSystem calls KillSystemInstances before mutating — benign but demands self-managed bucket

name: create_sound_cue
purpose: Create a SoundCue asset with an optional ready-wired wave-player chain — the 80% case for mod audio, matching 354 existing cues.
cooked: works — new loose cue referencing cooked/container SoundWaves; 3753 shipped waves reusable
hazards: Graph methods deref static ISoundCueAudioEditor TSharedPtr unchecked — ensure AudioEditor module loaded
SetupSoundNode has check(GraphNode == NULL) — never call twice on one node

name: add_sound_cue_node
purpose: Extend an existing loose SoundCue's node tree (attenuation/random/mixer/looping/wave player under a named parent slot).
cooked: refuses — container cue graph data stripped; duplicate_asset into /Game/MODS first
hazards: SetupSoundNode double-call check() applies — ConstructSoundNode already calls it

name: play_sound_preview
purpose: Audition any USoundBase (cue, wave, MetaSound source) through the editor's preview audio component — no viewport, no PIE.
cooked: works — highest-leverage audition path for 354 shipped cues + 185 MetaSounds
hazards: PlayPreviewSound returns nullptr with -nosound (null audio device) — map to a clean error, no crash

name: create_metasound_source
purpose: Create a playable MetaSoundSource (mono/stereo, one-shot or looping, optionally wave-backed) via the 5.3 document-builder API.
cooked: works — new asset creation; referencing cooked waves works
hazards: Build() asset-save/registration flow UNVERIFIED — prototype required before shipping
Wave Player FMetasoundFrontendClassName strings unverified — read from engine sources at impl time

name: set_physics_constraint
purpose: Wire a physics constraint component to its two bodies with correct init order — set_property on ComponentName1/2 is not equivalent.
cooked: works — constraints operate on live components regardless of asset origin

name: create_physics_asset
purpose: Generate a PhysicsAsset (bodies + constraints) from a skeletal mesh — from-scratch ragdoll/collision setup; 163 PhysicsAssets in game.
cooked: degraded — cooked-mesh behavior unverified (reads render data); must error cleanly, live test required
hazards: FScopedSlowTask.MakeDialog() on game thread (cpp:343-346,:903-906) — Slate re-entrancy mid-request; suppress
check(SkelMesh->GetResourceForRendering()) at cpp:500-501 — pre-verify render resources or check() fires

name: create_geometry_collection
purpose: Build a GeometryCollection from static meshes — Chaos destruction entry asset; game ships zero, no fracture, hence tier 3.
cooked: refuses — needs FMeshDescription (editor-only geometry); cooked meshes return null
